description: This file defines the VisibleCodeTracker class, which captures and manages information about visible code regions in VS Code editors, including handling diff info for git URIs and filtering security or ignore rules.

classes.name: VisibleCodeTracker
classes.description: A class that captures and manages visible code information in VS Code editors, including diff info and filtering.

methods.name: captureVisibleCode
methods.description: Asynchronously captures the current visible code regions across all editors, filtering out security concerns and ignored files, and extracts diff info.

methods.name: getLastContext
methods.description: Returns the last captured visible code context or null if none.

methods.name: extractDiffInfo
methods.description: Extracts diff information from a URI, particularly for git-related schemes.
